description: This PHP file defines a controller class 'EditJobVacancyController' within the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin. It extends an abstract Vue controller and is responsible for preparing data and configuration for editing a job vacancy, including setting properties such as vacancy ID, allowed file types, and maximum file size, which are passed to a Vue component.

classes.name: EditJobVacancyController
classes.description: A controller class that prepares a Vue component for editing a job vacancy by setting necessary properties such as vacancy ID, allowed file types, and maximum file size.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with vacancy details and configuration before rendering.
